title: Union Co-ops Council Public Call
description: The U.S. Federation of Worker Cooperatives' Union Co-ops Council, which builds bridges between worker cooperatives and organized labor, holds a monthly call that USFWC lists as public. Participants plan workshops at labor and co-op conferences, share information and resources about local union co-op projects, and arrange media exchanges. Free; 75 minutes on Zoom; English only. The council's own site is unioncoops.org.

recurrence.schedule: Usually the last Wednesday of the month, 4pm ET (1pm PT), 75 minutes on Zoom — but not always: November 2026's call is on Wednesday, November 18. Check USFWC's calendar for each month's date.
